### Added
- **`llmRouting.rateLimits` and `llmRouting.external.rateLimits`: token and request rate limits on the LLM endpoint** (giantswarm/giantswarm#38004). Each entry is one item of an AgentgatewayPolicy's `traffic.rateLimit.local`: `tokens` or `requests` per `unit`, optional `burst`, and optional `key`, a CEL expression through tpl giving each distinct value its own bucket. `agent-platform-connectivity-llm-rate-limit` targets the data-plane Gateway's `llm` listener, `agent-platform-connectivity-llm-external-rate-limit` the external route; empty (the default) renders neither. values.yaml shows a per-agent key, read from the kagent identity headers only behind the Substrate egress predicate, and a per-API-key one (`apiKey.name`). Buckets are kept per data-plane replica. Needs `components.agentgateway.versionRange` at 2.8.0 or later, whose CRD carries `key`. `make verify-llm-rate-limit` asserts the renders, the schema and both policies against the floor CRD.
